 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0031
 George Booker, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
September 25, 2025
Plaintiff's counsel:
Jennifer Black, Montoya & Solis Law Group
PARTIES
Plaintiff George Booekr is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to transact insurance business in the State of Texas,
which issued the liability and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage under which Plaintiff now seeks recovery.
FACTS
On October 9, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully parked in a designated space in a commercial parking lot in Pasadena, Texas. While
Plaintiff was stationary, a vehicle insured under Defendant's policy backed out of an adjacent space and struck the driver's side of
Plaintiff's vehicle. The insured driver did not check for oncoming traffic or pedestrians before reversing. Plaintiff reported the
collision to Defendant promptly and provided all information requested. Defendant accepted notice of the claim but has not
offered a fair settlement of Plaintiff's losses.
NEGLIGENCE
The insured driver owed a duty to other lot users to operate the vehicle with reasonable care, including keeping a proper lookout
and yielding when backing. The insured driver breached that duty by rveersing without looking and by failing to yield to
Plaintiff's stationary vehicle. This breach proximately caused the collision and Plaintiff's resulting injuries. Defendant is liable to
Plaintiff under the liability coverage of its policy for damages the insured driver caused, and Defendant owed Plaintiff a duty of
good faith and fair dealing in adjusting the claim under Texas law.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff sustained a lower back strain that has required medical evaluation, treatment, and
restricted activity. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and diminished capacity to work and perform daily
activities, and will likely incur further care. Plaintiff seeks recovery of actual damages in the amount of $174,000.00, together
with pre-judgment and post-judgment interest, court costs, and such other relief as the Court deems just.
